newsitem.title: GERMANY: Puma seeks another record profit in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Puma seeks another record profit in 1997.

text.p: German sportswear maker Puma AG said on Friday it aimed to achieve its fourth consecutive record profit in 1997 after reporting a 74 percent jump in net profit for 1996.
Puma said it expected operating profit to rise in 1997 and said sales would also grow due to good order levels.

Puma said group net profit rose to 83.8 million marks in 1996 from 48.2 million marks. Pre-tax profit rose to 64.9 million marks from 51.9 million. Earnings per share rose to 3.88 marks from 3.44 marks.
